lead.title: Chip stocks shed over $1 trillion as AI selloff deepens
lead.summary: Global semiconductor stocks lost more than $1T in market value in a single session, with Nvidia alone down $238B. SK Hynix (-$176B), Samsung (-$173B), Micron (-$113B), and AMD (-$110B) were also hit as China's chipmaking progress and circular-financing fears shake confidence in the AI boom. The selloff marks the deepest correction yet in the AI infrastructure buildout, raising questions about the sustainability of hyperscaler capital expenditure.

top_stories.title: US bans foreign-made humanoid robots, FCC cites national security risks
top_stories.summary: The FCC banned imports of new foreign-made humanoid and quadruped robots, citing supply-chain vulnerabilities and cybersecurity risks to US critical infrastructure. Industry experts warn the move could hinder innovation while boosting domestic robotics.

top_stories.title: GPT-5.6 Sol self-optimization delivers 20% cost cut and 15% token efficiency gain
top_stories.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-5.6 Sol autonomously rewrote its own production GPU kernels and designed speculative decoding architectures, achieving 20% lower serving costs and 15%+ better token-generation efficiency through stack-wide optimizations.

top_stories.title: Moonshot AI surpasses funding goal to hit $35 billion valuation
top_stories.summary: China-based frontier AI lab and developer of the Kimi K3 model raised $3.5B in a pre-IPO round at a $35B valuation, underscoring the massive capital requirements of the frontier AI race.

top_stories.title: ARC-AGI-3 score tripled with retained reasoning and context compaction
top_stories.summary: OpenAI showed that enabling retained reasoning and context compaction via the Responses API improved GPT-5.6 Sol's ARC-AGI-3 score by 188% while using 6x fewer output tokens, highlighting that benchmark scores heavily depend on harness and API settings.

items.title: GPT-Red: automated red teaming via self-play at scale
items.summary: OpenAI introduces an automated red-teaming agent trained to discover novel prompt injection attacks against frontier LLMs, used to adversarially train GPT-5.6.

items.title: StealthBench: measuring operational stealth in autonomous offensive-security agents
items.summary: A new benchmark that evaluates whether autonomous offensive-security agents can achieve objectives without revealing their presence, capabilities, or collected intelligence.

items.title: Constitutional midtraining: content presence drives alignment gains
items.summary: Researchers test whether inserting principled values-based content during midtraining can produce durable alignment that doesn't erode under fine-tuning, showing midtraining interventions can outperform post-training alignment.

items.title: HiFloat4: end-to-end FP4 reinforcement learning post-training for LLMs
items.summary: The first end-to-end FP4 RL post-training where both rollout and training policies operate at 4-bit precision. A systematic study reveals the dominant source of degradation is not training-side quantization.

items.title: SkillRise: agentic reinforcement learning for cross-task skill evolution
items.summary: A framework enabling LLM agents to accumulate and reuse skills across related tasks, treating skills as trainable states optimized through agentic reinforcement learning.

items.title: A.X K2 — 688B/33B MoE model drops on Hugging Face
items.summary: A large-scale sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 688B total parameters and 33B active parameters released by SKT. The community noted the relatively low active parameter ratio, with comparisons to DeepSeek V4 Flash.

items.title: LMSYS org open-sources Blackwell-native 8-bit and 4-bit RL stack in Miles framework
items.summary: LMSYS published a fully open-sourced stack for low-precision RL on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, supporting MXFP8 and hardware-native NVFP4 across rollout, forward, and backward passes. Results shown on Qwen3-30B-A3B.

items.title: Together AI's ThunderAgent accepted as ICML 2026 Spotlight
items.summary: ThunderAgent is an agentic inference scheduler that dramatically reduces KV cache thrashing, achieving 2.5x higher throughput and ~10x lower P50 latency at high concurrency with multi-node scaling.

items.title: OpenAI prototypes portable screen-free AI companion speaker
items.summary: OpenAI is prototyping a portable smart speaker functioning as a ChatGPT-like companion with cameras, sensors, onboard memory, and rechargeable batteries, though commercialization faces uncertainty.

items.title: Anthropic ships native sandboxed in-app browser in Claude Code Desktop
items.summary: Anthropic launched a native sandboxed browser built into Claude Code on desktop that reads web pages, clicks links, and interacts with elements, enabling documentation research and debugging alongside coding sessions.

items.title: Nvidia's $750B AI deal spree revives circular-financing fears
items.summary: Nvidia is working on fresh AI infrastructure deals worth over $750B, accelerating investments that skeptics warn are artificially inflating demand. Shares fell 5% as regulators scrutinize circular capital flows.

items.title: AI chips and data center capacity are doubling every nine months
items.summary: The NYT's interactive analysis shows AI compute is doubling every nine months, with hyperscalers pouring over $650B into data centers in 2026, straining power grids and creating physical infrastructure bottlenecks.

items.title: Qualcomm-powered humanoid robot collapses on stage at Computex 2026
items.summary: A humanoid robot running Qualcomm's new Dragonwing IQ10 AI chip collapsed face-first during a live demo, highlighting the gap between chip specs and real-world robotics reliability.

items.title: Generative Bionics unveils Gene.01 humanoid with full-body tactile skin
items.summary: Italian deep-tech startup Generative Bionics launched Gene.01, a humanoid robot with full-body tactile sensing and physics-native AI at AMD's Advancing AI 2026 event, built in six months.

items.title: South Korea unveils $880B 10-year plan for chips, AI data centers, and robotics
items.summary: South Korea announced an $880B public-private plan spanning semiconductors, AI data centers, and robotics to secure national leadership in next-gen chip manufacturing and AI infrastructure.

items.title: ChatGPT for Academic Researchers launched with free frontier model access
items.summary: OpenAI launched a program giving 10,000 scientists free access to frontier models including GPT-5.6, with plans to expand to 100,000 through 2027, including business-grade privacy and collaborative workspaces.

items.title: xAI releases Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 speech-to-speech model
items.summary: xAI released Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 with improved transcription accuracy, speech reasoning, and conversational performance. The high reasoning variant ranks #2 on the Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech Index.

items.title: Polar raises $5.7M for AI-first browser aimed at knowledge workers
items.summary: Polar, an AI-first browser founded by a former Perplexity engineer who built Comet, automates knowledge work for sales, recruiting, marketing, and research. Seed round led by Madrona.

items.title: Freehand raises $75M Series B to automate Fortune 500 supply chain spend
items.summary: $75M Series B co-led by Battery Ventures and NewRoad Capital Partners for autonomous AI agents managing supply-chain spend. Total funding reaches $100M.

items.title: Encore AI raises $30M to build AI agents that learn from customer calls
items.summary: $30M Series A led by Team8 for AI voice agents in customer support and sales, serving 40+ enterprise customers.

items.title: Pangram raises $9M to detect AI-generated content with 99%+ accuracy
items.summary: $9M led by Menlo Ventures for an AI text/image detection model that claims 99%+ accuracy on AI-assisted writing.
